facts.fact: The gaming industry in 2023 is estimated to exceed $300 billion USD, per a source cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: The gaming industry in 2023 is estimated to exceed [$300 billion](https://newsroom.accenture.com/news/global-gaming-industry-value-now-exceeds-300-billion-new-accenture-report-finds.htm) USD

facts.fact: By 2027, it is expected that there will be 3.8 billion gamers worldwide, per a Statista statistic cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: by 2027, it’s expected that there will be [3.8 billion gamers](https://www.statista.com/statistics/748044/number-video-gamers-world/) worldwide

facts.fact: In 2022, Insider Intelligence estimated that 54.2% of the US population were digital gamers.
facts.quote: In 2022, [Insider Intelligence estimated](https://www.insiderintelligence.com/insights/us-gaming-industry-ecosystem/) that more than half (54.2%) of the US population were digital gamers.

facts.fact: Mobile gaming was the largest segment in 2022, with 48.3% of the US population (162.9 million people) playing games on smartphones, per Insider Intelligence as cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: Mobile gaming was the largest segment, with 48.3% of the population (162.9 million people) playing games on their smartphones.
